overview.description: The Avantis All International Markets Value ETF (AVNV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that invests in international equity portfolios, typically heavily weighted towards developed markets outside the US. It seeks long-term capital appreciation through factor-investing, focusing on securities with value characteristics and higher expected returns. AVNV was launched on Jun 27, 2023 and is issued by American Century Investments.
